text:
mikaela: Heads-up: we're seeing a batch of webinar signups (utm=may_demo_series) and ~18 leads are landing as intake:unclaimed. HubSpot webhook latency spiked to ~65s and enrichment is timing out. Need a minimal, targeted fallback to preserve SDR SLAs.

devon: Can we scope the fallback to only the utm tag? If we blanket RR fallback we'll create noise.

tara: Agree on target. Proposal: if utm_campaign contains "may_demo_series" and enrichment_status==pending for >6s, assign owner to "SDR Webinars Queue" and set intake_flag suppress_task=true so reps get a digest rather than immediate tasks.

andre: Good. Also add an internal hs_fallback=true property so we can filter and later reconcile when enrichment completes. That avoids duplicate lead creation in SF.

olivia: I'll monitor SF duplicates and task counts. Rollback criteria: dup_rate > 2/min OR suppressed_tasks > 20 in 15m. If either hit, I flip rollback and notify Ops.

alerts-bot: HubSpot webhook latency alert: 65s avg over last 7m. Enrichment 504s spike at 11:07:14.

mikaela: Action list: 1) devon -> patch intake config (staging->smoke->prod) to add targeted fallback and suppress_task. 2) andre -> set hs_fallback property and add HubSpot note template. 3) olivia -> watch SF metrics and heartbeat in #inbound-handoff. 4) tara -> prep SDR digest copy and saved filter. 5) mikaela -> open follow-up ticket for enrichment robustness.

devon: Curl I'll use for staging canary:
```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://internal-config.redwood/api/v1/lead-routing" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"round_robin": {"targeted_fallbacks": [{"match": {"utm_campaign": "may_demo_series", "enrichment_status": "pending", "pending_seconds_gt": 6}, "owner": "SDR Webinars Queue", "intake_flags": {"suppress_task": true}, "hs_fallback": "true"}]}}'
```

mikaela: Great. Do staging smoke and ping when ready to flip. Keep changes for max 1h unless we extend.

olivia: On it 4aa will report back on dup/task windows.

andre: Adding HubSpot workflow note and saved filter now.

alerts-bot: Config patch applied to staging by devon at 11:09:02.

mikaela: Thanks team. We'll reconvene if anything unexpected shows up. :white_check_mark:
